title: pane.read
description: Returns a pane's history and screen as plain text, with no escape sequences, newest last and with no line ends after the last text. At most 1,000,000 bytes: past that the oldest text goes, cut at a character. Needs hello version 2 and a caller pane. The caller's own pane, one it spawned, or one they spawned (the self and children scopes) is answered at once; any other pane needs a window approval or live grant and is redacted. A redacted read with lines also looks at up to 128 lines above them, so when it starts inside a private-key block, the block's lines in it become one «redacted:private-key» line. Reads of the caller's own pane are not redacted.

pane.description: The target pane. A pane outside the self and children scopes raises a keyboard-only window prompt.

lines.description: Only the last this many lines. Wrapped rows join into one line. The core copies only the rows near the end that hold them, so a short read costs the same however long the history is.
